newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo sets up division for special cars.
newsitem.headline: Volvo sets up division for special cars.

text.p: Volvo Cars, a unit of Swedish automotive group AB Volvo, said on Monday it would set up a company for special vehicles such as police cars, ambulances, limousines and armour-plated cars.
"We discern considerable development potential in this market segment," Volvo spokesman Walter Fortgens said in a statement.

Last year the company manufactured 3,500 special cars and sold about the same number for local modification on various markets, Volvo said. The company estimates that the total European market is 150,000 vehicles annually.
